week_thesis: Fed's hawkish June 17 pivot (rate hike fully priced October 2026; PCE inflation forecast revised up to 3.6% year-end) adds a macro headwind for high-multiple AI growth names, but the structural AI semiconductor supercycle continues to overwhelm macro concerns. Our 3-position portfolio — AMAT (+50% from $411 entry, now $617), LLY (+11%, $1,099), NVDA (+2.4%, $210) — is at maximum capacity with all positions profitable. The dominant event this week is Micron (MU) earnings Wednesday June 24 after close: consensus $20 EPS / $34.7B revenue; company guided $19.15/$33.5B; MU has beaten by 21.7% average for 4 straight quarters with HBM4 supply fully sold out through 2026. If MU beats strongly, the semiconductor complex — including NVDA and AMAT — will rally Thursday. No position changes this week; hold all three with updated trailing stops and add MU to post-earnings watchlist.
